definition.definition: Byte-matched from refs/kitaev-2405.02434/approximate_algebras.tex: level one (tex:1125-1132): Y^\dag\cdot X=\braket{Y}{X}\,\wt{Q}, Y^\dag\cdot X=\Co_{Q}(Y^{\dag}X), \wt{Q}=\Co_Q(Q); |\braket{X}{X}-||X||^2| <= O(\delta+\eps)||X||^2. Extended (tex:1547-1549): same display on M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q} with \braket{Y}{X}=\sum_l \braket{[Y]_{l1}}{[X]_{l1}}. \wt{Q}=\Co_Q(Q) equals the corner-algebra compressed unit u_Q by definition. The false 1dQ_ip_norm_ext (tex:1551-1554) is NOT provisioned.
